briefing: Stocks rose today: the NASDAQ gained 1.5% and the S&P 500 gained 0.9%, led by growth and tech names. We have $345.88 in cash, which is below the $500 minimum for a new position, so we are not buying despite three open slots and several strong candidates (FROG, KRMN, LASR, LEU). All seven holdings stay in place, including NET at about -1.9% from cost, and the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules keep watching them.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, so the NASDAQ usually rises more than the S&P 500. Even on a risk-on day, a disciplined investor only buys when they have enough cash to build a properly sized position. Spreading too little money across extra trades adds costs and complexity without much benefit.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心增強，資金流向科技股等較高風險、較高增長的資產，因此納斯達克的升幅通常大於標普500。不過即使市況向好，紀律嚴明的投資者也只會在資金足以建立合理倉位時才入市。用太少的資金硬開新倉，只會增加成本和管理難度，實際作用有限。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks finished higher, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ (+1.5%) beating the broader S&P 500 (+0.9%), which signals investors were willing to take on more risk. Gains were spread across software, networking and growth names: many screened stocks such as FROG, KRMN and LEU show fresh bullish MACD crossovers and are trading above their 20-day averages. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and momentum data, not on a particular news catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日收高，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數升1.5%，跑贏標普500指數的0.9%，反映市場風險胃納回升。升勢遍及軟件、網絡設備及成長股板塊，FROG、KRMN、LEU等多隻篩選股份的MACD剛出現黃金交叉，股價亦企穩於20日均線之上。由於今日未有具體新聞標題可供引用，以上分析僅根據價格及動能數據，並非針對個別消息作解讀。
